detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Cinema Manager Simulator 🎬 is a first-person simulation and management game where you take control of your very own cinema.

Build, customize, and manage your dream cinema! Schedule movies, sell tickets, serve delicious snacks, and keep your customers happy. Expand your business, upgrade your equipment, and turn a small theater into an entertainment empire!

🎮 Better Together!

Team up with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players! Divide jobs, manage daily operations, and run your cinema together.

🎟️ Run the Show!

Choose movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, upgrade your equipment, and expand your theater. Every decision counts!

🍿 Snacks & Arcade Fun!

Prepare popcorn and cotton candy, then take a break to enjoy playable arcade mini-games with your friends!

🛋️ Make It Yours!

Customize your cinema with furniture and decorations to create your perfect movie theater.

🐈 Meet the Cats!

Adorable cats roam around your cinema! Pet them, give them names, and enjoy their company.

Build it. Customize it. Manage it. Enjoy it — together!

Are you ready to run the show? 🎬
